id.description: Unique identifier for each instance of the job.

startTime.description: Start date and time of the job in UTC format.

lastUpdated.description: Last update date and time of the job in UTC format after a step execution completion.

statusMessage.description:
Status for the overall steps that are part of the job.
 * `STARTING` - Job has started.
 * `STARTED` - Job is in progress.
 * `COMPLETED` - Job has completed.
 * `FAILED` - Job has failed.
 * `UNKNOWN` - Job status is unknown.
 * `ABANDONED` - Job has been abandoned (manually stopped).

exitCode.description:
Overall result of the job.
 * `UNKNOWN` - Job is in progress.
 * `COMPLETED` - Job has completed.
 * `FAILED` - Job has failed.
 * `COMPLETED_WITH_ERRORS` - Job has completed with errors.
 * `COMPLETED_WITH_PENDING_ORDERS` - Job has completed with pending number orders.

createdTime.description: Creation date and time of the job in UTC format.

timeElapsed.description: Time elapsed in seconds since the job execution started.
